subject: Audit snapshot for data residency & access (who/when) - follow up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@vera-fin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit snapshot for data residency & access (who/when) - follow up

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the clarity on Vera's Q3 audit scope. Per our call, here's a short recap and the data items we discussed for the "who/when" access snapshot you requested.

Scope requested
- Timeframe: 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 (Q3)
- Environments: production model endpoints only (prod-us-east-1)
- Records: "who accessed what/when" for inference requests and console/admin actions
- Columns you asked for: UTC timestamp, actor_type (end-user, service, admin), actor_id (hashed), action (generate, embed, config_change), resource_path (model id, route), model_version, request_id, session_id, source_ip (redacted or hashed), retention_tag

Format & delivery options
- Preferred formats: CSV or newline-delimited JSON (we recommend CSV for bulk audit exports)
- Delivery: secure S3 upload (we support customer KMS) or an expiring Drive link
- Redaction options: we can provide salted HMACs of user identifiers (customer-provided salt) or tokenized IDs per your policy

Questions / confirmations needed from Vera
1) Do you want raw timestamps in UTC (ISO8601) or epoch ms?
2) Confirm whether we should salt/hash email addresses and IPs, or redact them entirely.
3) Delivery mechanism preference (S3 with KMS alias, or Drive link)

Attachments
- who_when_schema.pdf (sample schema with column definitions) [Attachment: who_when_schema.pdf]

Next steps / timeline
- If you confirm scope and delivery, we can produce a 48–72hr sample extract (up to 5k rows)
- Full export estimated 10–15 business days after PO/legal clearance

I'll loop in Rishi (technical lead for exports) and Neha (security/PM) for timeline and technical details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: who_when_schema.pdf]

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@vera-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@deltacloud.io>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit snapshot for data residency & access (who/when) - follow up

Thanks Marissa — clear summary.

We need the sample extract for Q3 (2026-07-01 -> 2026-09-30) to hand to our internal auditors on 10/22. Preference is S3 delivery to a Vera Finance bucket. We'll provide a KMS alias. A couple of clarifications:

- For actor_id, we prefer a reversible pseudonymization is NOT required. A salted HMAC hash is fine; we will provide the salt in a secure channel.
- Please remove full email addresses and redact IP addresses; hashing IPs is acceptable if you can demonstrate collision resistance for our audit.
- Include a column that indicates data residency (e.g., us-east-1) for each row so our legal team can validate residency claims.

Miguel Torres from our cloud ops team is cc'd — he'll coordinate the bucket and KMS key.

Appreciate a 48–72hr sample for auditors by 2026-10-20 if possible.

Regards,
Sophie Martin
Head of Compliance | Vera Finance
sophie.martin@vera-fin.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0139

[Quoted on reply]
> On Oct 18, 2026, at 9:12 AM, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Hi Sophie,
> > Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the clarity on Vera's Q3 audit scope. Per our call, here's a short recap...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@vera-fin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit snapshot for data residency & access (who/when) - sample & delivery plan

Sophie — thanks for the details. Looping Rishi and Neha to confirm the technical approach and timeline. Below is the proposed delivery plan and our answers to your clarifications.

Delivery plan (proposed)
- Sample (5k rows, representative): delivered within 48–72 hours to your S3 bucket (we'll request write access and KMS alias) — target: 2026-10-20
- Full export: 10–15 business days after receipt of PO and completed DPA amendment (if needed)

Hashing / pseudonymization approach
- We can produce salted HMAC-SHA256(actor_identifier, customer_salt) for actor_id.
- We will not include plaintext email addresses; we will either redact or emit an HMAC depending on your preference.
- source_ip can be redacted or hashed — hashed by default with the same HMAC approach unless you request full redaction.

Schema & columns (sample attached)
- timestamp_utc (ISO8601), actor_type, actor_id_hmac, action, resource_id, model_version, request_id, session_id, source_ip_hash, data_residency, retention_tag

Example (first 3 rows of attached sample access_snapshot_q3.csv):
"2026-07-02T14:23:05Z, end-user, 3b9f5c2a..., generate, /models/gpt-4x, v1.2.3, req-8a2f, sess-xy12, d2f8a1..., us-east-1, 30d"
"2026-08-11T09:02:44Z, admin, 5f1a9d4c..., config_change, /console/settings, -, -, -, -, us-east-1, indefinite"
"2026-09-29T20:11:10Z, service, 8c3e7b1f..., embed, /models/embed-1, v3.0, req-c3b7, sess-jk98, e4b7c3..., eu-west-1, 365d"

Notes / risk items
- If any rows are tagged eu-west-1 we will surface them separately (data residency exceptions) — please confirm whether Vera requires redaction or a residency exception log included in the export.
- For audit reproducibility: we can include a brief readme with hashing algorithm, salt exchange instructions, and a checksum manifest.

Attachments
- access_snapshot_q3.csv (sample, 3 rows) [Attachment: access_snapshot_q3.csv]
- who_when_schema.pdf (previously sent)

Next steps for Vera
1) Share preferred delivery (S3 bucket + KMS alias) or Drive link and a contact that can grant write access.
2) Confirm whether IPs should be hashed or fully redacted.
3) If everything is green, we'll queue the sample for 48–72hrs.

Rishi / Neha: can you confirm ETA for the sample once we have bucket/KMS?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: access_snapshot_q3.csv]

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@vera-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@deltacloud.io>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit snapshot for data residency & access (who/when) - confirmation

Marissa / team — thanks for the fast turnaround.

We confirm:
- Delivery: S3 to s3://vera-fin-audit-exports/redwood/2026-q3. Miguel will grant write + provide KMS alias (alias/vera/audit-key).
- Actor_id: salted HMAC-SHA256 is acceptable; Vera will transmit the salt via our secrets manager with Miguel.
- IPs: please hash IPs (HMAC) rather than retain plaintext.
- Residency column required for every row.
- PO: PO-99872 (attached to this thread in our procurement system) — legal will reach out if DPA amendments are needed, but proceed with the sample.

Can you provide a small checklist (2–3 bullet items) we can share with auditors that explains what the sample contains and how hashing was done? Also happy to book a 20-minute sync tomorrow with Rishi to confirm technical details.

Thanks — sample deadline of 2026-10-20 end-of-day is confirmed.

Sophie Martin
Head of Compliance | Vera Finance
sophie.martin@vera-fin.com
